summary: reviewer checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Reject new proposals, experiments, production requests, queue expansion, requeues, telemetry requests, spending, monetization, launch changes, and unsupported revenue or ROI claims. Preserve only existing execution-reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch work.
Update existing workstreams only. Do not create or requeue work until deduplication, ownership, root cause, focused validation, rollback, and queue eligibility are documented.

Continue measurement with available impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and AI cost only. Preserve unknown revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, incrementality, causal lift, cost-to-learn, infrastructure cost, labor cost, and operational health.
Continue containment of existing failures. Record root cause, isolated repair, validation, rollback, ownership, deduplication, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition before any requeue.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture from authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Keep missing controls unknown; do not access credentials, change permissions or configuration, deploy, or claim certification.

Keep the gated product private. Continue internal evidence and unsent permission-request preparation only; no outreach, public exposure, monetization, alert expansion, configuration change, or deployment without owner and counsel decisions.

Owner message: the plan is containment-only because 191 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failure repairs remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only one outcome is proven. Available revenue covers one day, with $4.92 aggregate commission unassigned to sites and no site-attributed commission; financial, causal, and operational conclusions remain unsupported. Drain existing work and keep private gates unchanged.
